records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero product progress (no project, no invite, no milestone) and no tickets or customer replies to outreach [email:f5c0b416]. Onboarding call was held [calendar:6ab13e03], showing some intent, but nothing followed in the 4 days since, so unaided activation within 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: Picking up from our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, the quickest first step is usually creating one project and adding a few tasks to it. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if that's easier.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that came up after we spoke.

Best,
Chidi
